name: stale_aggregate
description: In `add_lineitem` (POST /api/orders/{o_orderkey}/lineitems), a new lineitem is inserted without recalculating and updating `orders.o_totalprice`. The read endpoint `get_order` returns this stale `o_totalprice` value, which no longer reflects the actual sum of lineitems. Detection signal: write to detail table (`lineitem`) without corresponding update to precomputed aggregate (`orders.o_totalprice`).
